messages:
iona: heads-up: starting IonYX LoRA merge preflight. Sparse LoRA (block_size=32, sparsity~60%) appeared to shift tokens for >512 seqs. Need quick evals on q4_0 / q4_1 / q4_a to quantify regressions. tagging @sam @tara for infra + evalpack.

sam: on it. which base model and LoRA artifact? any custom tokenizer mapping?

iona: base: r/eleuther/phi-2b (customer pinned). LoRA: ionyx_sparse_v1. tokenizer has a few custom merges for emoticons/emoji. observed token-id shifts in rare tokens. I'll prepare a lightweight evalpack `merge-preflight-light`.

tara: I can spin a dedicated run. prefer run order: q4_0 -> q4_1 -> q4_a, and also keep a float16 baseline. disable prefix cache to reproduce deterministic behavior.

jess: adding eval sets: `ionyx_dialogs_v1` (50 convo turns), `cust_api_calls_small` (20 calls), and 10 targeted hallucination prompts. will attach prompt templates.

sam: quick reproducible command I use:
```bash
redwood eval run --pack merge-preflight-light --model r/eleuther/phi-2b --lora ionyx_sparse_v1 --quant q4_0 --dataset ionyx_dialogs_v1 --cache disabled --out /tmp/ionyx_q4_0.json
```

iona: perfect. @dev-bot can we capture per-token latency + likelihood delta vs baseline and produce divergence distributions? need top-k divergence (k=5) and instr-follow metrics.

dev-bot: Scheduled run: merge-preflight-light on r/eleuther/phi-2b + ionyx_sparse_v1 (q4_0). Job id: 82421. ETA ~12m. I will post results when done.

oliver: :eyes: I'll watch instruction-following and truncation cases. If instr-follow delta > 1% we consider a fail for this customer (they requested <1% drift).

tara: if tokenizer shift shows up, we'll generate a tokenmap remap. sample cmd: 
```bash
tokenmap remap --source cust_tokenizer.json --target reference_tokenizer.json --out remap_ionyx.json
```

jess: also watch for answer truncation around 256->512 boundary; structured sparsity sometimes leaks KV offsets which shows up there.

dev-bot: Job 82421 completed. Results: latency +12% vs baseline, top-1 likelihood delta -0.023, instr-follow delta -0.8%. Artifacts: /artifacts/82421/merge-report.json

iona: thanks. can someone kick q4_1 and q4_a next? I'll triage and propose remap or remerge if regressions exceed thresholds.

sam: launching q4_1 now, will post job id.

dev-bot: Scheduled run: merge-preflight-light q4_1. Job id: 82422. ETA ~10m.

dev-bot: Job 82422 completed. Results: latency +18% vs baseline, likelihood delta -0.041, instr-follow delta -1.6%. Artifacts: /artifacts/82422/merge-report.json

iona: that's larger than acceptable for IonYX SLA. quick mitigation options: 1) remerge keeping first N layers dense (N=4) 2) reduce sparsity in important blocks 3) try alternate quant backend q4_a or different kernel combos.

oliver: could also route high-sensitivity endpoints to dense fallback for short prefixes, use routing policy in console.

tara: I'll open a quick merge ablation to keep layers 0-3 dense and re-run q4_1. tagging @jess for QA thresholds.

jess: running ablation now (keep 0-3 dense). command: `merge_tool --keep-dense 0,1,2,3 --sparsity 0.6 --out ionyx_sparse_v1-merged-v2` then run same evalpack.

dev-bot: Opened job 82423 for ablation and eval. ETA ~11m.

dev-bot: Job 82423 completed. Results: instr-follow delta -0.6%, likelihood delta -0.015, latency +14%. Artifacts: /artifacts/82423/ablation-report.json

iona: great — this meets the <1% instr-follow drift SLA. let's package as `ionyx_sparse_v1-merged-v2` and prepare a canary rollout (5% -> 20% after 24h) with automatic rollback on instr-follow >1%.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll tag the model and add canary routing in console.

jess: locking evalpack and config: `merge-preflight-light@ionyx_sparse_v1-merged-v2` and saving artifacts to customer folder.

iona: closing loop: I'll update onboarding doc and ping CSE for sign-off. thanks all.
